q2_gaps: a temporal restriction on a kind-level copular generic ("Moth-counts are strong through summer"): Time atoms attach to an event witness and this clause reifies no eventuality, while ConditionalProperty's condition slot is specified for states, measures/environments and locative/domain PPs — not time spans — and nothing carries the "through" (throughout) force
notes: The bare-plural generic on the kind, the moth_count genus with the noun modifier left unexposed, the suppressed bare Inheritance, and the 0.9/0.9 empirical TV are all right. Routing the seasonal frame into the condition slot extends the locative-restriction rule, but it is the only alternative to dropping the restriction, which the instruction set forbids.
